sentences.text: This i s first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.209/2023 dated 28.06.2023 registered at Police Station Lalbarra, district Balaghat, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 323, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 29.06.2023.
The applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district Balaghat and is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed b y the Court.
The trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
According to prosecution, the age of prosecutrix was more than 17 years at the time of incident.

In her statements and the FIR she has claimed that she was raped by the applicant in the month of December 2022 but the later facts reveal that she accompanied the applicant to Waraseoni and Nagpur and she stayed there with him for almost three months.
Even after returning to her parental house, she did not immediately lodged the FIR.
Looking to the overall circumstances of the case, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE ps Date: 2023.07.21 10:39:16 +05'30'
